validation: July–December of the preceding year; each year uses a newly trained frozen model. Evaluation ends 2026-08-31.
trainingSampling: Two signal opportunities per UTC day per asset; predictions on every completed 4-hour signal.
target: Independent candidate net return divided by initial dollar risk budget, using the shared leveraged execution primitives, actual funding and trailing stop. Clip training target to [-3,6]; report unclipped realized account results.
selection: Pick highest validation return minus maximum drawdown with at least 20 closed trades, separately by model family. Break ties by fixed model/window order. If none eligible, retain baseline; all candidates still reported.
dailyContext: Auxiliary logistic regression for BTC 14-day direction. Coin Metrics daily prices from 2014 for fitting, cutoff strictly before prediction year. Predict normalized daily features from Binance futures history (source transfer); never label 2014 daily prices as leveraged trade outcomes. all/5y/3y apply separately to both context model and available futures labels.
dailyContextAblation: Include boost-all without the auxiliary daily model.
exitSelection: Compare exit variants only on the selector chosen from the prior validation period; do not select a winner from evaluation returns.
costStress: Double fees and slippage, unchanged actual funding.
limitations: All evaluation years were already examined in prior experiments; exploratory historical comparison, not fresh holdout evidence.
Current BTC/ETH/SOL asset selection; no cross-sectional universe expansion in this first selector experiment.
Overlapping labels are not independent trades; training subsampling reduces but does not eliminate overlap.
Daily context may not improve future returns; no uncalibrated score presented as win probability.
